title: Bankruptcy on a credit report
facts: Federal credit-reporting law can permit bankruptcy information to remain on a consumer report for up to 10 years from the order for relief or adjudication, subject to applicable law and reporting practices.
Other negative information often has shorter federal reporting periods.

Credit reporting duration is different from how long a bankruptcy case lasts and from how long discharged debts remain legally collectible; discharged debts generally cannot be collected personally regardless of report display.
